bull_bear.body:
- Strategic capital raise at the broking subsidiary: 'Choice International and NH Investment & Securities Establish Strategic Partnership Through f9000 Million Investment in Choice Equity Broking' - investor NH Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., investee Choice Equity Broking Private Limited, structure 'Primary Capital Infusion through Compulsory Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS)', with a footnote that the 'Deal Executed in Q2 FY26'.
- Stated objectives of that infusion: accelerate growth of Choice Equity Broking, strengthen the capital base, expand the MTF book and settlement funding portfolio, enhance technology capabilities, adopt global governance standards and create sustainable long-term value.
- Stated deployment of capital: 'Working capital & capital expenditure', 'Strategic acquisitions' and 'Growth initiatives across the broking and wealth management business'.
- NBFC balance-sheet position shown as CRAR 43.36%, PCR 27.67%, GNPA 3.78%, NNPA 2.74% and net interest margin of 11.10% in Q1 FY27, which the deck describes as 'Reduced by 20 bps'.
- Funding is described as a 'Well-diversified Liability Profile' / 'Balanced Liability Profile' with 'Ample Liquidity & Positive ALM', drawing on banks (HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, IDFC First Bank, Federal Bank, Bandhan Bank, DCB Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, Capital Small Finance Bank, ESAF Small Finance Bank) and financial institutions (SIDBI, Poonawalla Fincorp, Ambit Finvest, Western Capital, InCred Finance).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Core competencies claimed are PAN India presence, an institutional & retail research desk, priority sector lending, government partnerships and tech-enabled operations, across stock broking, wealth products, insurance distribution, MSME lending, government advisory and investment banking.
- Advisory is positioned against Big-4 and global engineering consultants (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Accenture, IBM Consulting, AECOM, RITES, Egis, IPE Global, WAPCOS, Feedback Infra) across 13 named sectors, with a stated 'combined addressable annual consulting opportunity exceeding f90,000 crore'.
- Vision 2030 for consulting: 'To become India's most respected integrated government, infrastructure, and development consulting firm', built on national leadership, a multi-sector platform, execution-led excellence, technology-enabled delivery, global presence and thought leadership.
- Investment banking arm Choice Capital Advisors Pvt. Ltd. is described as 'a SEBI-registered Category-I Merchant Banker', and the NBFC as 'Empowering MSMEs through retail lending tailored specifically for the dynamic semi-urban and rural landscapes'.
- Broking platform is framed as 'A client-first trading platform converting infrastructure depth, product curation & investor education into durable engagement and diversified revenue'.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Merger/rename] Footnote to the entity structure: Choice Wealth '*Merged with Arete Capital Services Pvt. Ltd. w.e.f. from 11th May 2026; ROC approval for renaming to Choice Wealth Pvt. Ltd. obtained on 14th July 2026.'
- [Group structure] Entity structure as of 30th June 2026: Choice Equity Broking 90%, Choice Consultancy Services 90%, Choice Finserv 82.34%, Fintoo Wealth 51%, with Choice Wealth, Choice Insurance Broking, Choice Connect, Choice Tech Lab, Choice AMC, Choice Trustees, Choice Capital Advisors, Choice Unified Services, Choice Corporate Services, Ayoleeza Consultants and Ellora Solutions each at 100%.
- [IB franchise] Investment banking shows 30 ongoing IPO mandates with f67.6 Bn of 'Tentative Fund Raising', plus a completed-deal table of 16 IPOs/rights issues/open offers with issue sizes, subscription multiples and listing gains (deck's marker: '#As of 01st July 2026'; '*Acted as an Underwriter to the Issue').
- [Event] InsightX 2026, a flagship 3-day virtual investor conference held 10-12 June 2026, covering 101 companies, 150+ investors, 20 sectors and 14 research sessions.
- [Auditor / memberships] Auditors named as MSKA & Associates LLP, 'A Member firm of BDO'; registrations shown across NSE, BSE-linked memberships, MCX, NCDEX, NSDL and CDSL.
